background.description: Plain white paper, signed three times in black ink

notes: UPSC's requirement is unusual and confirmed directly from the official CSE 2026 notification (Note 3, How to Apply): sign THREE TIMES, one below the other, on a single sheet of plain white paper using black ink, then scan/photograph all three signatures as one image. Do not upload a single signature. The exact pixel/KB figures (350-500px, 20-100KB) come from UPSC's separate online FAQ page (upsconline.nic.in), which could not be directly fetched for this verification — confirm before relying on the exact pixel dimensions.
